question: How can I reset my password?
answer: You can reset your password by selecting Forgot Password on the login page and following the reset link sent to your email.

question: Why can’t I log in to my account?
answer: Check that your email and password are correct. If you still cannot sign in reset your password or contact support.

question: How can I change my email address?
answer: You can update your email address from the profile section of your account settings.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can contact support through the help center or by emailing support@example.com.

question: When is customer support available?
answer: Customer support is available Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern Time.

question: Can I cancel my subscription?
answer: You can cancel your subscription from the billing section of your account settings. Your access remains active until the end of the current billing period.

question: Can I pause my subscription?
answer: Subscription pausing is not currently supported. You may cancel your subscription and subscribe again later.

question: How do I upgrade my plan?
answer: You can upgrade your plan from the billing settings. The new plan becomes available immediately.

question: What is the refund policy?
answer: Refund requests can be submitted within 14 days of purchase. Approval depends on the circumstances of the request.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Payments may be declined because of incorrect card information insufficient funds or restrictions from your bank.

question: How can I update my payment method?
answer: You can update your card or payment information from the billing section of your account settings.

question: Where can I download my invoices?
answer: Invoices are available in the billing section under payment history.

question: Is my personal information secure?
answer: Account information is protected using security controls including encrypted communication and restricted access.

question: How can I enable two factor authentication?
answer: You can enable two factor authentication from the security section of your account settings.

question: How can I delete my account?
answer: You can request account deletion from account settings. Account deletion permanently removes your account after the confirmation process.
